messages:
Maya Singh (CSM): FYI we just noticed CedarLabs drops to ~0 traffic after 2024-06-22 14:18 UTC. Renewal in ~7w. Procurement pinged asking for updated SOC and SSO notes.
Oliver Grant (AE): thanks. any signs they opened an RFP or running a PoC?
Maya Singh (CSM): Procurement language is neutral but the infra mailing list mentions 'infra consolidation + internal proxy'. No explicit vendor names.
Rosa Kim (Solutions): Quick hypothesis: service mesh rewrites outbound host -> header stripping. If so, calls silently stop. Cal, can you check edge logs and any 4xx spikes?
Cal (Support): Pulling logs now. Last successful call 06/22 14:17 -> 200. At 14:19 we see several 502/403 from their proxy IPs then silence. No server-side errors on our end.
redwood-bot: Reminder — open renewal-watch RW-2024-489 and link to account cedarlabs.
Maya Singh (CSM): RW-2024-489 created. I'm drafting an ops note to offer a 30-min remediation session and a one-week dedicated pilot to keep them live during migration.
Oliver Grant (AE): Offer looks good. Also flag Sales leadership if they confirm a competitor PoC.
Rosa Kim (Solutions): I'll prepare a 1-pager: curl health-check, common mesh rewrites, header whitelist checklist, and a fallback regional endpoint. Snippet: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"ping"}'`
Cal (Support): Found three blocked egress entries at 14:19 with our IP in denied list. Sharing trace excerpt in the invite.
Maya Singh (CSM): I'll push the trace + ask them to whitelist our egress and run the curl. Scheduling a 20-min ops sync tomorrow 09:00 PT with procurement + infra + AE.
Oliver Grant (AE): If they push back on cost, offer the one-week Dedicated trial (no charge) and migration concierge. If they ask for deeper concessions escalate to AM lead.
Maya Singh (CSM): Agreed. Treat as high-priority renewal watch until we confirm routing change or competitor pilot. Update after sync. :handshake:
